# ERW coverage

What the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW) holds today: one row per table in `warehouse/output/`. This is the seed of the metadata table the IRW (Item Response Warehouse) calls `metadata.csv`.

**Generated, do not edit by hand.** Rebuild with `python warehouse/validate/build_coverage.py`. Every value comes from the table's own rows, its provenance header, or `erw_validate.py`. Row counts include any forward day-ahead days listed under operating days.
